Ability to design topologies with redundancy, failover, and scalability as deployments evolve. Ability to explain network issues, tradeoffs, and design decisions to non-technical operators and stakeholders. Strong written documentation skills for SOPs, troubleshooting guides, topology diagrams, and configuration standards. Understanding of RF and satellite principles, including link budget basics, latency and packet loss behavior, and interference troubleshooting.
